question: In a certain code language, 'GREEN' is written as 'HTHIS' and ‘SAFFRON’ is written as ‘TCIJWUU’. How will 'WHITE' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8455c0124707b57e9f800e56eb0150ffa573557ee5dad7bdd2e126a53d24539f.png] 

The logic is as follows

**'GREEN' is written as 'HTHIS'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e892072471ddcf11f043e0024cea62350ec9bfcc239bc34c902f34589aa13fa.png] 

**‘SAFFRON’ is written as ‘TCIJWUU'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3428efadde66d0046d94cd00be84decae3d1aa9fd6f8b55ef4f791fcbb4e384.png] 

**'WHITE' be written '?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f75fb0a490e9c731600f205051e1a3f912da50a60254b68138f294438784a111.png] 

**'WHITE' be written 'XJLXJ'**

Hence, the correct answer is **option(1)**
